newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine bonds turn lower on U.S. Treasuries.
newsitem.headline: Argentine bonds turn lower on U.S. Treasuries.

text.p: Argentine bonds turned around an early rise to end slightly lower Wednesday, following a decline in U.S. Treasuries after data showed a smaller-than-expected fall in U.S. September home sales.

"It's natural that there is some profit-taking after three days of gains," said a trader at an Argentine brokerage house. Market players reported that activity was fairly slim again, reflecting the thin flows seen in recent weeks.
Argentina's FRB due 2005 fell 3/8 to 81-1/2, while the dollar-denominated Bocon Previsional 2 due 2001 slipped $0.05 to 118.15.
